calls.video_title: Affirm is Appreciated By Consumers and Merchants as it Facilitates Sales
calls.thesis: Reiterated BUY (first tracked call) but conviction downgraded medium→low: fairly valued on DCF, slightly undervalued overall at 14.8x forward earnings; rates and macro are worse than at his late-August buy ranking.
calls.base_case: BNPL virtuous cycle (merchants attract consumers and vice versa): revenue $250M in 2020 → $4B TTM, record operating-cash-flow/sales, revenue per employee $1.7M; consumer balance sheets are healthy, unlike pre-GFC.
calls.bull_case: Merchant-network expansion compounds adoption in an industry that could reach billions of customers; AI keeps lifting employee productivity.
calls.bear_case: Fallout from excess government borrowing, higher interest rates and a macro slowdown; valuation less attractive than a month and a half ago.
